name: The web family by lineage: web server, TUFTE, VICTOR, GEODE, L-Space
asks: we have a web-server; TUFTE works over that; VICTOR is a static site publisher over that; GEODE is a knowledge vault specialization of TUFTE. I think? ... These applications are meant to form the family of upstream capabilities such that l-space is literally just an instance of one of them.

x-provenance.recorded-by: office agent of the 561 Group (Lenticule Science Senior and Red Cup Engineer Senior), development pass sigrid-publishing-1 of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus
x-provenance.basis: The Leader's utterances cited in `sources`, read in full. `asks` and `sources[].words` are the Leader's own words; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: we have a web-server; TUFTE works over that; VICTOR is a static site publisher over that; GEODE is a knowledge vault specialization of TUFTE. I think? ... These applications are meant to form the family of upstream capabilities such that l-space is literally just an instance of one of them.

requirements.says: The web family shall comprise a web server, TUFTE operating over the web server, VICTOR as a static-site publisher over TUFTE, and GEODE as a knowledge-vault specialization of TUFTE.
requirements.rationale: [0iCMIjxvyPJM]: the Founder's statement of the lineage, held with 'I think?' for GEODE; [rRVcN_o5thQg]: VICTOR 'is just meant to be the publish HTML from a TUFTE server'.

requirements.says: L-Space shall be an instance of one member of the web family.
requirements.rationale: [0iCMIjxvyPJM]: 'l-space is literally just an instance of one of them'.

requirements.says: VICTOR shall publish HTML from a TUFTE server and shall carry no website logic that TUFTE carries.
requirements.rationale: [rRVcN_o5thQg]: 'it sounds like right now it carries some logic about websites that TUFTE should have.'

requirements.says: VICTOR shall carry nothing that FeltOS needs.
requirements.rationale: [JV7Brq1sirt0]: 'VICTOR is a static site publishing app, why is it handling ANYTHING that feltos might need?'

requirements.says: Each application of the web family shall meet, and then beat, the current real-world software of which it is the house styling.
requirements.rationale: [XgcDTujL6T-U]: 'we basically want to continue moving them to meet then beat the current real world software they're house stylings of'.

requirements.says: The research of the science sections on the public frontier of each such software's field shall be extended and cited by the application's specification.
requirements.rationale: [XgcDTujL6T-U]: 'extending the research we have in our science sections about the current public frontier of these fields, and ... draw on our own mathematical and philosophical theories'.

requirements.says: The applications of the web family shall render and publish Living Web information.
requirements.rationale: [XgcDTujL6T-U]: 'these are applications for rendering that type of information and publishing/serving to that type of information'.

requirements.says: The Founder's local web server shall listen on one fixed, configured port.
requirements.rationale: [5fy1XJ40QU6A]: 'make sure that there's a consistent port on localhost it goes to so I can bookmark it in my browser'.

conditions.says: The glossary terms TUFTE, VICTOR and GEODE and the web family's README describe the same lineage.
A search of VICTOR's source finds no website-logic function that TUFTE exports and no FeltOS-needed capability.
The local server started twice listens on the same port both times.

board-opening.context: Held already: the TUFTE, VICTOR and GEODE glossary terms (each in its app's `content/text/glossary/terms/`), the note `2026-09-27-note-on-returning-victor-to-publishing.md` (TUFTE 23 mentions), the Living Web science section, and the requirement `assist-shared-engine-downstream-of-tufte.json`. The Founder does not love VICTOR's backronym (utterance ...XgcDTujL6T-U); the TUFTE name was fixed on 2026-08-27 to the Founder's wording (`Tiling User Form Topology Engine`, as the glossary term now reads). The GEODE-as-TUFTE-specialization claim is the Founder's, uncertain at the time; the GEODE term says GEODE composes CAIRN capabilities into a VICTOR website whose forms and topology come from TUFTE.

sources.words: Well, lets fix the name of TUFTE to what I said, and I don't *love* VICTOR's backronym.
